mechanism: Isotretinoin causes severe teratogenicity and metabolic effects; empagliflozin may potentiate metabolic stress and euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis risk in susceptible patients, with additive effects on lipid metabolism.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, ensure strict contraception compliance (isotretinoin), monitor glucose control closely, assess for DKA signs, and monitor lipid panels regularly given both drugs affect lipid profiles.
